title: How Rollup Sequencing & State Proofs Works
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    subgraph L2["L2 Rollup"]
        U[User submits L2 tx] --> SEQ[Sequencer orders and batches]
        SEQ --> EXEC[Execute batch off-chain]
        EXEC --> ROOT[Compute new state root]
    end
    subgraph L1["L1 Settlement Layer"]
        POST[Post batch data to inbox] --> PROOF[Submit validity or fraud proof]
        PROOF --> VERIFY{Real proof verified?}
        VERIFY -->|Yes| FINAL[Finalize state root]
        VERIFY -->|No| REJECT[Reject root]
        FINAL --> BRIDGE[Bridge honors withdrawals]
    end
    SEQ --> POST
    ROOT --> PROOF
    U -. censored .-> FORCE[Force-include via L1 inbox]
    FORCE --> POST

title: Bypassed Proofs and Sequencer Abuse
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[Attacker or rogue operator] --> CHOICE{Pick weak assumption}
    CHOICE --> V1[Trust-door in finalization]
    V1 --> V1a["finalizeBlocksWithoutProof()"]
    V1a --> WRITE[Write false L2 state root]
    CHOICE --> V2[Unbounded proof index]
    V2 --> V2a[historicalSummaryIndex unchecked]
    V2a --> FORGE[Forge withdrawal proof]
    FORGE --> WRITE
    CHOICE --> V3[Forced-batch weaponization]
    V3 --> V3a[Force and self-sequence batch]
    V3a --> ROM[Trigger proving ROM bug]
    ROM --> WRITE
    CHOICE --> V4[Censorship, no escape hatch]
    V4 --> FREEZE[User funds frozen forever]
    WRITE --> DRAIN[Finalize fake root]
    DRAIN --> STEAL[Drain L1 bridge]

title: Hardening Proofs and Sequencing
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    START[Rollup hardening checklist] --> D1
    subgraph Proofs["Proof integrity"]
        D1{Finalize always verifies?} -->|No| F1[Remove proof-bypass paths]
        D1 -->|Yes| D2{All proof indices bounded?}
        D2 -->|No| F2[Range-check each subtree index]
        D2 -->|Yes| OK1[Proof system sound]
    end
    subgraph Sequencer["Sequencer limits"]
        D3{L1 force-inclusion exists?} -->|No| F3[Add L1 escape hatch]
        D3 -->|Yes| D4{Forced batch bounded?}
        D4 -->|No| F4[Bound ROM, canonical RLP only]
        D4 -->|Yes| OK2[Censorship resistant]
    end
    subgraph Downstream["L2-aware downstream"]
        D5{Oracle gates on uptime feed?} -->|No| F5[Add sequencer-uptime check]
        D5 -->|Yes| D6{Aliased senders handled?}
        D6 -->|No| F6[Un-alias forced-message sender]
        D6 -->|Yes| OK3[Safe on rollup]
    end
    OK1 --> D3
    OK2 --> D5
